goal: Validate the parallel workflow using two isolated audits of the current prototype; preserve active UI design

tasks.goal: Review service.mjs, content tests and content/data specifications. Write a concise source audit to specs/development/validation/prototype-content-audit.md. Do not modify product code.
tasks.acceptance: Report actual baseline SHA, reviewed file:line references, passing checks, concrete findings or a bounded no-findings conclusion, and production gaps separately. No keys or runtime data.

gates.name: report-present
argv: from pathlib import Path; p=Path('specs/development/validation/prototype-content-audit.md'); assert p.is_file() and p.stat().st_size > 200

tasks.goal: Review prototype startup, OS settings and App Store entrypoints against current concept specs. Write specs/development/validation/prototype-shell-audit.md. Do not modify product code or UI.
tasks.acceptance: Report actual baseline SHA, reviewed file:line references, checks, concrete inconsistencies or a bounded no-findings conclusion. Explicitly separate source observations from browser verification.

gates.name: report-present
argv: from pathlib import Path; p=Path('specs/development/validation/prototype-shell-audit.md'); assert p.is_file() and p.stat().st_size > 200
